title: Bumper Program — Final Cape Canaveral Phase Calibration Manifest
purpose: Freeze the complete final Cape Canaveral phase of the eight-round Bumper V-2/WAC Corporal program as a finite human-made sky-event calibration corpus before inspecting Blue Book or POSS-I outcomes.

source_titles: 75 Years Ago: First Launch of a Two-Stage Rocket
70 Years Ago: First Launch from Cape Canaveral
authority.program_scope: Eight Bumper rounds total; first six were completed before the JANUS study window. The complete final Cape Canaveral phase inside the study window consists of one documented scrub followed by Bumper 8 and Bumper 7 launches.
authority.source_semantics: NASA states Bumper 7 was prepared for 1950-07-19 but scrubbed after delays; Bumper 8 launched 1950-07-24; Bumper 7 launched 1950-07-29, ending the program.

campaign_scope.location: Cape Canaveral Long Range Proving Ground, Florida, USA

events.reason: Launch delays left the V-2 filled with liquid oxygen for about nine hours; moisture buildup contributed to a valve failing to open, so the launch was scrubbed.

events.notes: First rocket launch from Cape Canaveral. V-2 lifted off; WAC Corporal separated but its main motor failed to ignite.
Final Bumper program launch. Corporal separated and fired for about 40 seconds; program ended after this round.

bluebook_direct_attribution_requires: witness geography compatible with Cape Canaveral / downrange Florida-Atlantic launch context
within-day ordering compatible if case and launch times are available
narrative morphology not inconsistent with a brief rocket/missile event
poss_direct_attribution_requires: Palomar actually observed on the date/time window
POSS field geometry plausibly intersects the Cape/downrange rocket apparent direction
candidate morphology is compatible with a rocket/brief luminous trail after plate integration
pre_outcome_attribution_gate.scrub_date_role: Operational/publicity/program context without an airborne rocket. A same-date witness signal on the scrub date cannot be directly explained by an airborne Bumper vehicle.

allowed_inference: Calibration/attribution only. Three records are too few for a population rate claim.
forbidden: No inference that non-Bumper days are globally rocket-free.
No direct attribution from date alone.
No rate/enrichment p-value presented as evidence from this three-record phase.
No outcome-dependent expansion of the final Cape phase after this freeze.
